title: BPE Tokenizer
description: BPE Tokenizer explains Byte Pair Encoding tokenization for large language models. It describes why subword tokenization is used, how BPE learns merges, how byte-level BPE differs from classical character-level BPE, and what tokenizer behavior means for context length, rare words, code, IDs, and serving systems.
